symbols.name: EntityFrameworkDocumentStoreProvider
symbols.summary: Persists serialized documents with one dependency-injection-owned Entity Framework scope per operation.
symbols.remarks: The provider never captures a caller-owned DbContext. Every operation creates, uses, and disposes its own scope and TContext, which makes singleton document clients safe. Entity mapping is defined by annotations on BridgingIT.DevKit.Infrastructure.EntityFramework.StorageDocument and mutations use database transactions and concurrency versions where required.

syntax.content: public class EntityFrameworkDocumentStoreProvider : IDocumentStoreProvider, IDocumentStoreRetentionProvider where TContext : DbContext, IDocumentStoreContext
